title: reminder.scan-continuation.v1
description: SQS command emitted in the SAME TransactWriteItems as every ReminderScanLease transition (acquire/reclaim/checkpoint-with-more-pages) - D-300 (reminder-producer-implementation-plan-scoping/DECISION.md §2/§4). Consumed by the dual-trigger reminder-producer-handler.ts's SQS path, which runs scan-page.ts for the (shardFnVersion, shardId, minuteISO) the message names.

tenantId.description: D-300 §4: the SYSTEM tenant sentinel (events.ts's SYSTEM_TENANT_SENTINEL) - this is a system-owned scan coordination message, never a real tenant's.

lastEvaluatedKey.description: Canonical-serialized (fixed key order, never raw JSON.stringify) ExclusiveStartKey - absent for a fresh start (page 1).

rolloutEpoch.description: D-300 §8: SCAN_MODE_EPOCH at production time - fences residual messages from before a rollback/roll-forward cycle.
